target: Paisaje de navegación del Claro de la Niebla Baja en la Ribera Sombría.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Pequeño espacio abierto de transición donde la humedad suele quedar cerca del suelo; la reducción de luz hacia Nhal debe ser evidente.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Create a wide landscape of Claro de la Niebla Baja. A small irregular clearing interrupts the increasingly dense Nhal-edge canopy. Thin natural ground fog hugs wet soil, roots and low vegetation while trunks remain clearly visible above it. The clearing is modest, not a meadow; a route crosses it and disappears again into darker forest. Moisture from Lethra is still present, but the dominant change is reduced light and enclosed visibility. Cool gray-green daylight.
negative_constraints: No glowing mist, spirits, runes or magical beams
No large meadow or sunny field
No horror-monster silhouette hidden in fog
No characters or creatures as focal subject
